guardrails.rule: Only objects listed under targets are changed. All other object settings are preserved from the retrieved file.
Availability-driven: every target is checked against the connected org. Objects not in the org are skipped and reported, never treated as a failure (applies to all rows, not only skipIfAbsent).
Level 1 = programmatic deploy. Only rows that fail programmatically (or stay mismatched after the recalculation wait) go to Level 2 = browser (browser-fallback.md).
External access must not be more permissive than Internal - a spec violating this aborts the run (fix the spec; neither deploy nor UI can apply it).
Access reductions (internal or external, incl. leaving ControlledByParent) are computed at plan time from the retrieved files; deploy requires --confirm after user approval.
Always retrieve fresh (retrieved-before is cleared); abort if retrieve is not Succeeded.
Changing Account also changes its ControlledByParent children (Contact, Order, ...). Report them.

If a deploy fails: isolate the failed objects, redeploy the rest, and send the failed rows to browser fallback. If browser Save fails on rows not in targets, or is rejected for a listed row: STOP and ask the user - never change values on your own (strict scope). Systemic deploy failures (auth, timeout, no component errors) abort instead of falling back.
Never cancel a DeployRequest created by "Automated Process".

steps.step: Query EntityDefinition (InternalSharingModel, ExternalSharingModel) for all target objects; save owd-before.json.

Clear sharing/_work/retrieved-before (script-owned work project), then sf project retrieve start -m CustomObject:<Object> (present objects only, deployAs=self) --output-dir sharing/_work/retrieved-before

Set sharingModel/externalSharingModel to target values in each object-meta.xml; add externalSharingModel if missing; write to sharing/_work/force-app/main/default/objects/<Object>/ (never the caller's project).
Wait (never cancel) while any DeployRequest is in flight, then sf project deploy start --source-dir <each patched object-meta.xml> --async; poll sf project deploy report every 15-30s.
Re-query EntityDefinition; compare to targets; re-check once after ~2 min if mismatched (sharing recalculation is async). Save owd-after.json.
For rows still not at target: follow browser-fallback.md (Setup > Sharing Settings > Edit), then re-run verify.
Write step0-sharing-result.md (before/after/target/status per row) and append to deploy-log.
